title: Huawei Reportedly Developing Wider Nova Flip Phone
excerpt: Huawei is reportedly preparing a wider Nova Flip phone for 2027 featuring a 6.3-inch screen.
body_html:
Huawei is reportedly working on a new design for its upcoming compact foldable device. According to reports, the company is preparing a wider version of the Nova Flip.

The planned device is expected to feature a 6.3-inch screen. Reports indicate that this potential design change is targeted for release in 2027, bringing a different shape to the brand's lineup of compact foldable phones.
